# Malan Family Dentistry

> Comprehensive family dental practice in Rockingham, NC offering restorative, cosmetic, and specialized treatments for patients of all ages.

Malan Family Dentistry is a full-service dental practice located at 715 South Long Drive in Rockingham, North Carolina. The practice specializes in both preventative care and advanced dental procedures including cosmetic treatments, restorative solutions, and specialized therapies like sleep apnea management.

## Key Topics

- Dental Implants
- Cosmetic Dentistry

- Restorative Dentistry

- Family Dentistry

- Rockingham, NC
- Patient Education

## Restorative & Replacement Dentistry

- [Dental Implants](https://malanfamilydentistry.com/dental-implants): Dental implant replacement teeth solutions at Malan Family Dentistry.
- [Dental Crowns & Bridges](https://malanfamilydentistry.com/dental-crowns-and-bridges): Dental crowns and bridges for tooth restoration in Rockingham, NC.
- [About Dentures](https://malanfamilydentistry.com/about-dentures): Denture restoration service to restore smile and function.
- [Root Canal Therapy](https://malanfamilydentistry.com/root-canal-therapy): Root canal therapy endodontic procedure to save natural teeth in Rockingham.
- [Tooth Extraction](https://malanfamilydentistry.com/tooth-extraction): Tooth extraction service for non-restorable teeth in Rockingham, NC.
- [Dental Fillings](https://malanfamilydentistry.com/dental-filings): Dental fillings and cavity treatment for all ages in Rockingham.

## Cosmetic Dentistry

- [Invisalign Clear Aligners](https://malanfamilydentistry.com/invisalign): Invisalign clear aligner treatment for teeth straightening at Malan Family Dentistry.
- [Teeth Whitening](https://malanfamilydentistry.com/teeth-whitening): Professional teeth whitening take-home treatment service in Rockingham, NC.
- [Dental Veneers](https://malanfamilydentistry.com/dental-veneers): Porcelain and resin veneer cosmetic dentistry service in Rockingham.

## Specialized Treatments

- [Sleep Apnea Support](https://malanfamilydentistry.com/sleep-apnea): Sleep apnea oral appliance and CPAP alternative treatment in Rockingham.
